Sandbox_SmoothRide_Enabled_tooltip: Off: every player sees other players' cars with vanilla sync. Applies at once, also when an admin changes it in a running game.
Sandbox_SmoothRide_Mode_tooltip: Same for every player. Balanced: other cars are drawn about 80 ms behind. Smooth: even smoother for about 40 ms more (120 ms, still 4x less than vanilla's 500). Realtime: the lowest delay, more prediction; cars may get corrected on sharp manoeuvres.
Sandbox_SmoothRide_SendIntervalMs_toolti: How often a driver sends their car's state: 33 = 30 times a second, 150 = vanilla (no boost). Same for every player.
Sandbox_SmoothRide_MaxPredictMs: Bridge server hitches up to, ms
Sandbox_SmoothRide_MaxPredictMs_tooltip: When the server stalls (world save, loading new map areas) no car updates come through. A moving car keeps going on prediction this long instead of freezing, then slows to a stop. 2500 covers the hitches of a big modded co-op host.
